title: Smith, Lyle & Moore Hunt #2: Glimmer

prize.note: 3,177,700 sats, funded in a single transaction on 2022-07-29, unspent

target_format: BIP39 12 words, English wordlist, plus a passphrase, BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, P2WPKH

derivation.summary: 12 BIP39 words plus a passphrase, scattered across 3 password-gated web pages, derived along BIP84 to a P2WPKH address matching the escrow; the author separately published the account xpub
derivation.certified_against: the published account xpub, whose m/0/0 P2WPKH address equals the escrow; a known-wrong BIP39 test vector is also confirmed to produce NO MATCH. The BIP39-mnemonic-to-seed leg has no known-good vector, since 0 of 12 words are held

difficulty_note: the South lock (b3vye, "Name 6") is now solved: the answer is 'Dr. Roy' (period and space), the Professor Roy Hinkley under a different title; the branch runs past it (Mary Ann, then an island page) to three new gates, of which raft-escape and smoke-signals are the live frontier and death is a probable dead end. West and East remain unopened. Each gate takes a specific author-intended riddle answer, not a decodable cipher; a public solver reports ~250,000 failed guesses on the island exits, so these are insight gates. The Glimmer song/video is the likeliest source for the island and East answers but its lyrics are unpublished and the video is served only from the site
